newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Singapore still mulling zinc contract.
newsitem.headline: Singapore still mulling zinc contract.

text.p: The Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) has not yet made up its mind whether to launch a zinc contract in 1997, its general manager said on Thursday.
"We have no timing yet...No decision has been taken yet on the zinc contract," Lim Toh Eng said in an interview at an Asia coffee conference here.
"We're focusing more on our rubber because we just launched a rubber FOB contract," he said.

Lim was referring to the new TSR20 rubber contract implemented on an FOB basis from the October/December 1997 contract and is denominated in U.S. cents per kg. The previous system was on an award basis.
SICOM had already postponed the launch of the zinc contract last year.
